body.x: Rainbow Winter(www.rainbowwinters.com) announced 'Rainbow Riot' at the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The 'Rainbow Riot' is crafted from 'Luminous Tex' and an embedded pressure sensor 'Pressure Sensor Tex', so the wearer has the power to change the color of the dress depending on their mood or surrounding. In a riot of rainbows, sculptured geometric hexagons turn the wearer into a walking work of art.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
